objective: Bring the Phaser game in src/ in line with the GDD, Tier 0 first, by closing the highest-value gaps.

goals.title: Extract testable requirements from the GDD
goals.desired_state: facts/gdd-requirements.json lists every GDD requirement with id, text, tier and source chunk ids

goals.title: Inventory what src/ implements
goals.desired_state: facts/code-inventory.json lists every feature found in src/ with file evidence and test coverage

goals.title: Compare requirements with code
goals.desired_state: facts/gaps.json classifies every requirement as met, partial, missing or contradicted, with evidence

goals.title: Rank the gaps
goals.desired_state: facts/priorities.json is an ordered queue of gaps with score, rationale, owning code agent and files allowed
goals.note: 27 queue items (26 gaps) + 2 deferred; top: Grunt Jab Combo; 4 actionable now, rest needsOwner

goals.title: Implement the top-ranked gap
goals.desired_state: The top open item in facts/priorities.json is implemented with tests, and facts/generated.json records the change

goals.title: Review the generated change
goals.desired_state: facts/review.json holds a pass/fail verdict with findings; npm test is green
